zh.name: 西湖景区
zh.summary: 西湖景区以湖泊、堤岸和周边山地步道为核心，适合结合路线难度选择步行、跑步等户外活动。
highlights: 可按体力选择不同距离的路线
tips: 出发前确认天气、开放区域和路线状态
节假日及热门时段注意避开拥挤路段
长距离活动请准备饮水并合理安排返程时间

en.name: West Lake Scenic Area
en.summary: West Lake Scenic Area combines lakeside paths, causeways, and nearby hill trails for walking, running, and other outdoor activities of varying difficulty.
highlights: Routes with a range of distances
tips: Check weather, access notices, and route conditions before departure
Avoid crowded sections during holidays and peak hours
Carry water and plan your return for longer routes

zh.name: 西湖区
zh.summary: 西湖区拥有湖滨、丘陵、村落和城市绿道等多种路线环境，可根据运动类型与距离筛选合适路线。
highlights: 适合多种距离和运动类型
tips: 山区路线注意坡度和路面变化
进入景区、村落或保护区域时遵守现场规定
请根据天气和个人体力选择路线

en.name: Xihu District
en.summary: Xihu District offers lakeside paths, hills, villages, and urban greenways, with routes suited to different activities and distances.
highlights: Options for different distances and activities
tips: Watch for steep or changing surfaces on hill routes
Follow local notices in scenic, village, and protected areas
Choose routes according to weather and personal fitness
